title: Act deemed to be included in the schedule of the Mobile Courts Act, 2009
chapter: Chapter VIII — Offences, Penalties, and Trial
text: Act deemed to be included in the schedule of the Mobile Courts Act, 2009.— This Act shall be deemed to be included in the Schedule of the Mobile Courts Act 2009 (Act No. 59 of 2009).
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
